name: Wailing Caverns

entrance.note: Lushwater Oasis cave southwest of the Crossroads. Nalpak and Ebru stand in the cave before the instance portal. Coordinates from Questie dungeons.lua via dungeons.json.

travel.how: From the Crossroads, run southwest to Lushwater Oasis and enter the cave at 46.0, 36.5; grab the cave-mouth quests on the way down to the portal.

quests.name: The Forgotten Pools
quests.notes: Barrens prereq of 877. Already a nova/v2/barrens-12-20 step; dungeon pack must not replay it.

quests.name: The Stagnant Oasis
quests.notes: Barrens prereq of 880. Bubbling Fissure at the Stagnant Oasis. Already in the Barrens pack.

quests.name: Altered Beings
quests.notes: Barrens prereq of 1489 (turned in at barrens-12-20 before the WC placeholder). Oasis Snapjaw shells. Do not replay in the dungeon pack.

quests.name: Hamuul Runetotem
quests.notes: Two-minute breadcrumb from Tonga after Altered Beings. Unlocks 1490 / Leaders of the Fang.

quests.name: Nara Wildmane
quests.notes: Talk breadcrumb on Elder Rise. Unlocks 914. steps-v2 places this after the run; a single clear needs 1490 and 914 before entering.

quests.name: Deviate Hides
quests.notes: 20 Deviate Hides inside. Catalog speedrun:true (1600 at 17). races 0 (any faction). Barrens pack already completes this at the cave mouth (barrens-12-20:104); dungeon steps omit it so it is not played twice.

quests.name: Raptor Horns
quests.notes: Outdoor Barrens prereq of 1491. Stays on the Barrens route; do not pull the horn farm forward for the dungeon.

quests.name: Trouble at the Docks
quests.notes: 99-Year-Old Port from Mad Magglish in the winding cave before the portal (insideDungeon false in catalog). Catalog speedrun:false because of that extra cave objective.

quests.name: Serpentbloom
quests.notes: 10 Serpentbloom. Catalog marks insideDungeon false; questie-db zone is Wailing Caverns and the blooms are picked inside the instance. Zamah is in the Spirit Rise pools.

quests.name: Smart Drinks
quests.notes: Wailing Essence from Evolving Ectoplasm inside. Accept after barrens-12-20:125 (Raptor Horns 865, both routes). The run stays at barrens-12-20:135.

quests.name: Deviate Eradication
quests.notes: 7 Ravagers, 7 Vipers, 7 Shamblers, 7 Dreadfangs. Cave-mouth giver with Nalpak. Catalog speedrun:true. Barrens placeholder also accepts this; one clear only.

quests.name: Leaders of the Fang
quests.notes: Gems of Cobrahn, Anacondra, Pythas, and Serpentis. Main WC reward quest. steps-v2 accepts it after the run; pick it up before entering if you want the gems on the same clear. Catalog flags Anacondra insideDungeon false; she is inside the instance.

quests.name: The Glowing Shard
quests.notes: Drops from Mutanus the Devourer on this clear only; do not reset for it. Falla Sagewind is on the hill above the oasis. Horde follow-up is 3369 (Alliance 3370 is not in the Horde questie import).

quests.name: In Nightmares
quests.notes: Horde-only follow-up of 6981 (races 8589934770). Not in the dungeons.json WC quest list; in steps-v2 and questie-db (2000 XP). Turn in on Elder Rise with 1489/1490/914.

prep.group: 5-player, dungeon levels 17-24; do not enter before 20 (runAt).
consumables: dispel/poison cleanse if the healer has it
warnings: Finish Tonga's 870/877/880 on the Barrens before taking 1489.
Pick up 1487 (and 1486 if not already done) from Ebru/Nalpak in the cave before the portal.
Mad Magglish for 959 is in the winding cave, not inside the instance.
Grab 962 from Zamah if you pass Thunder Bluff; Serpentbloom is inside.
Need 1490 then 914 before the clear if you want Leaders of the Fang on this run; steps-v2 currently accepts 914 after the run.
Skip 1491 unless 865 is already turned in.
Druids of the Fang cast Sleep and heal; pull deviate packs back to corridors.
One clear only; 20-40 has an unexpanded WC placeholder that must not start a second run.

speedrunReplaceCandidates.why: Kolkar, Stolen Silver, scytheclaw nests, and the Wizzlecrank escort in nova/v2/barrens-12-20 are the 18-20 Barrens slog; WC at 20 pays more for one clear.
levels-20-40.route-v2 still has Serena Bloodfeather, Camp Taurajo quillboar, Lost in Battle, and Counterattack after 20; WC XP can cover that band.

sourceConflicts: 1486 is catalog speedrun:true but has no dungeon step ids; Barrens pack already completes it at the cave mouth.
865 and 1491 are in dungeons.json; steps-v2 omits them because 865 is turned in after the Barrens WC placeholder.
870/877/880 are in the catalog as WC prerequisites but have no dungeon step ids (Barrens pack owns them).
steps-v2 accepts 1490 and 914 after dungeons:wailing-caverns:run; a single clear needs those before entering so the four gems drop. Step ids recorded as they exist.
962 Serpentbloom: dungeons.json objectives.insideDungeon is false; questie-db zone is Wailing Caverns and blooms are inside.
914 Lady Anacondra is flagged insideDungeon false in dungeons.json; she is inside the instance.
3369 is in steps-v2 and questie-db but omitted from the dungeons.json WC quest list.
Classic Era XP; catalog notes Forever may halve dungeon-quest bonus XP (unofficial).
notes: Pickup hub is Crossroads / Lushwater Oasis and Thunder Bluff at 16-22. Dungeons-off replacement: stay in the Barrens (Crossroads, Camp Taurajo) and go to Stonetalon around 18-22. Alliance-only 3370 In Nightmares dropped. XP is Classic Era from dungeons.json / questie-db.
